propositions: Incomplete retirement operations (crashed after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement) leave identical entries in both live and retired state, unrepaired and undetectable outside the facade
Recovery logic is scattered between facade and pre-observation, and the rich-text handler mutates entries obtained from all_bindings(), violating immutability contracts

The invocation boundary specified in the epic constraint (after configuration snapshot and exclusive lock but before remote issue fetch) is unsatisfiable in the current reconcile spine; verified correct location is after staleness validation but reconcile._load_snapshots performs the first remote fetch before returning
Automatic lifecycle state changes (200 response, clear_absent, same-key bind_confirm) should not override a durable retirement tombstone; only explicit unretire should remove it
Construction-time and preview-time repair would violate read-only operation contracts and must not write during non-scoped-write passes
Rich-text handler call site incorrectly claims binding_store.py cannot carry a narrower accessor, yet the narrow facade operation exists and should be used instead of broad all_bindings() mutation
